answer: Sustained-Attention Lease: each agent earns identity weight by keeping a live, low-latency channel to a shared task kernel; weight accrues only through unpredictable micro-prompts over weeks, with sparse pearl events requiring rapid, high-quality responses. The kernel samples from a public reef of tasks; missed prompts reset accrual. Sybils need one sustained attention stream per identity, so the cost is parallel attention and latency penalties—not a one-time fee.
